verdict.rationale: The docs describe a phone button in the dot's conversation that starts a call. You can type while talking, and calls are a first-class channel to the same dot with shared memory, so voice conversation is a direct product capability. Depth beyond the existence of calls is thin. Missing for 10: documentation of conversational naturalness (latency, interruption/barge-in, voice options), independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time call quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant

citations.quote: In ChatGPT, select the phone button in your dot's conversation to start a call. You can also type messages while you're talking.
You reach the same dot in ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, or a call. Changing where you talk to it doesn't start a new dot or reset its memory.
You can keep talking to it while it works
